purpose: mechanism and pipeline diagnostic; not a public-source benchmark
library_policy: one frozen memory bank is shared by all 50 independent queries
notes: No MemConflict, HaluMem, or STALE records are included; their source data were not present locally.
All pair labels are exhaustive for the generated bank and derive from explicit subject/slot/scope metadata.
This pilot has no double-annotator agreement study and should not be presented as a human-validated benchmark.
Queries are single-claim; multi-claim, coreference, aliases, and uncertain cases are deferred.
